featured_reviews.name: Harshil Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I often watch movies at Miraj Cinemas Dattani, mainly because it’s convenient and close by. If you don’t want to travel far and just want to catch a movie nearby, it does the job.
That said, you do have to compromise a bit on the overall experience. The sound and screen quality are decent but not premium, and the seating comfort could definitely be better. The overall ambience feels slightly outdated compared to newer cinemas in other areas.
Cleanliness is acceptable and the staff is fine, but nothing really stands out. It’s more about convenience than a high-end cinematic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: The theater has comfortable chairs with ample leg space, and the place is clean and well-maintained. Each seat has a QR code to order food easily, which is then delivered directly to your seat. During the interval, staff also come around to take snack orders, making the experience hassle-free. The AC is perfectly set, not too hot and not too cold. Also both the screen and sound quality are also good

There were so many mosquitoes. The plugs where the recliners were connected were in bad state and almost broken. Highly disappointed.

featured_reviews.review_text: Miraj Cinema at Dattani Mall in Vasai is a cinematic delight! The state-of-the-art facilities combined with impeccable service make it the ultimate destination for movie buffs. The plush seating and crystal-clear screens elevate the movie-watching experience to new heights. The staff are friendly and efficient, ensuring a seamless experience from ticket booking to popcorn munching. Whether you're catching the latest blockbuster or indulging in a classic film, Miraj Cinema delivers top-notch entertainment. Plus, the convenient location within Dattani Mall makes it easily accessible. If you're in Vasai and craving a dose of cinematic magic, Miraj Cinema at Dattani Mall is the place to be! Highly recommended for an unforgettable movie-going experience.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Tivarekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a disappointing experience at the theater. The staff lacked knowledge about ticket information, leading to confusion. We arrived 15 minutes late, and our seats were occupied due to their error. The staff were unaware of ticket details and couldn't identify the correct seating. The manager eventually resolved the seat issue but refused a refund for the wasted 45 minutes of the movie, which we missed due to their irresponsibility. We had booked 6 tickets costing Rs. 280, and the wasted money adds to the dissatisfaction. The experience was unsatisfactory, and the management's response was inadequate. The staff's behavior was unprofessional, with one occupant arguing without knowledge, and the manager's attitude was unhelpful, stating "I can't say anything to the customer, they are my customer", making us question who we were in the situation. I suggest to avoid this theater

Want to go back but wish they showed multiple movies instead of just 1 movie I saw yesterday called Bad News. But over all would recommend it people staying in Parell who doesn’t like too much crowd & who value their privacy, this is the go to spot.

featured_reviews.review_text: It's located in Mira Road East, rickshaws are available from the metro station as well as the railway station to reach here. featured_reviews.name: Akash Mhapankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited MovieMax Mira Road for a movie, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience. The theatre is well-maintained, clean, and comfortable. The seats are spacious with good legroom, and the picture and sound quality were excellent, making the movie even more enjoyable.

The staff was polite and helpful, and the overall ambience felt premium. The refreshments counter also had fresh and tasty snacks at reasonable prices.

Overall, it’s a perfect place for a relaxed movie outing with friends or family. Highly recommended for a great cinema experience

featured_reviews.name: CS Rahul Taori
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited MovieMax Mira Road, and overall it was a good experience, especially considering its proximity to my residence.
The biggest advantage of this theatre is its location and convenience — very easy to access if you stay nearby, making it a go-to option for quick movie plans without much travel hassle.
Talking about the theatre itself, the seating, screen quality, and sound system are quite decent. It may not be ultra-premium, but it delivers a comfortable and enjoyable movie experience.
One major downside, however, is the food and beverages. The pricing is quite high compared to the quality and quantity offered. Honestly, it doesn’t feel worth the money, and this is something they really need to improve.
On the positive side, ticket prices are affordable, which balances out the experience to some extent and makes it a budget-friendly entertainment option.
Final Verdict:
A convenient and reliable theatre for regular movie outings, but avoid spending much on food inside.
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

featured_reviews.review_text:

It would really help if stricter monitoring is enforced during screenings—perhaps with staff conducting periodic checks or clear announcements requesting audiences to maintain silence. Better crowd management and ensuring basic theatre etiquette would go a long way in improving the experience for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Mhapankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently went for an evening show of De De Pyaar De 2, and it turned out to be a great choice. The movie was full of comedy, light moments, and entertainment — we enjoyed every bit of it.

After the movie, we headed to the food court to grab something to eat. We tried their pizza and red sauce pasta, both of which were tasty and satisfying. For drinks, we had orange juice and strawberry bubbles — refreshing and perfect after a long movie.

Overall, it was a fun and enjoyable outing with good entertainment and good food. Would definitely recommend both the movie and the food court experience!

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Dj Anu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

(Attached image: the staff member present at the time, wearing a white shirt and teal trousers.)

Pathetic service, untrained staff, and totally unprofessional behaviour. Never coming back.

featured_reviews.name: nigam sarvaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located conveniently near the National Park in Veena CHSL, Shantivan, Borivali East, Sona Gold Digital Cinema offers a cozy and budget-friendly movie-watching experience for local residents and casual visitors alike.

The theatre may not be as flashy as the big multiplexes, but it holds its charm with a nostalgic feel and a simple setup. The seats are decent and comfortable enough for a casual movie outing, and the sound and picture quality are surprisingly good for the price. It’s a great option for spontaneous plans or watching the latest releases without burning a hole in your pocket.

What stands out is the affordable ticket pricing and convenient location – perfect for locals looking to catch a film without heading to a crowded mall. Staff are polite and helpful, and entry and exit are generally smooth. While the snacks and facilities are basic, they do the job, and cleanliness is maintained reasonably well.

Pros:
- Affordable ticket prices
- Convenient location near National Park
- Decent audio-visual quality
- Friendly staff

Cons:
- Limited screen and seat capacity
- Basic amenities and snack options
- Less suitable for those looking for a premium experience

Overall, Sona Gold Digital Cinema is a reliable neighbourhood theatre that delivers on value. Great for everyday moviegoers and those who appreciate a more laid-back, no-frills cinema outing.

Rating: 3.8/5

featured_reviews.name: Alok Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie Time is just a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Metro Station, but finding it was a bit of a struggle since there were no signs outside to guide us. Unlike most theatres, there’s no clear entry point, which made things confusing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Now, let’s talk about the seats—definitely not the most comfortable. Sitting through a long movie was a bit of a task. On the plus side, the food area was clean, but the prices? Almost as high as PVR, which felt a bit much for the overall experience.

One good thing—they have free underground parking for both bikes and cars, which is a rare win in Mumbai!

Overall, if you’re nearby and just want to catch a movie, it works. But if you’re looking for a top-tier cinema experience, this might not be the best pick.

featured_reviews.name: Dhaval Gami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the management. Every time I visit this theatre, I face the same issue regarding my bike helmet. Visitors arriving on two-wheelers are not allowed to carry helmets inside, yet there is no proper and secure facility provided to keep them. Customers are forced to leave their helmets outside at their own risk.

This is an inconvenience and a basic customer service issue that has remained unresolved despite repeated visits. If the theatre does not allow helmets inside, it should provide a safe and organized storage facility for riders.

I request the management to address this issue seriously and implement a proper solution instead of making customers face the same problem every time.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Sir, I would like to explain you about your concern we have a Cinema Parking in the basement area.We had always ask the audience to please Park at the Authorize Parking and keep their helmet on it.We have also assured the customer that it is our responsibility of the vehicle which is parked in our parking.Next time whenever you come for the movie please Park your vehicle at the cinema basement.

**Abstractions:**
Movie Time offers a modern and hip atmosphere. The decor is stylish, and the seating is decent and comfortable, making it a great value for money if not a great place to relax before the movie starts.

**Screen Quality:**
The screens are large and well placed, providing a clear picture. The sound quality is impressive, which enhances the overall movie experience. The sound quality is also great.

**Concessions:**
A good selection of snacks and drinks is available. The popcorn is fresh and buttery, you can grab a biscuit here, there is nothing else to eat.

**Staff:**
The staff is friendly and efficient, ensuring a smooth ticketing and concession process.

**Overall Experience:**
Movie Time offers a pleasant movie watching experience with its great facilities and atmosphere. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to have a good night at the movies.
